爱莎贝儿-151CM-L 粉肤 RAD041 蝶野未梦Chono Miyu-吞噬
她慵懒靠在暗红丝绒上，
火红长发如焰般披散，紫眸含笑勾人。
她轻咬下唇，纤指滑过锁骨，
低语道：“来呀……让我用身体，吞噬你全部的欲望。”
空气中弥漫着甜蜜的诱惑，
尾巴轻轻缠上你的腿。
胸型：151CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-151CM-L Pink RAD041 Chono Miyu-Devour
She leaned languidly against the dark red velvet,
her fiery red hair cascading like flames, her purple eyes alluring with a smile.
She lightly bit her lower lip, her slender fingers tracing her collarbone,
and whispered, "Come... let me devour all your desires with my body."
A sweet temptation filled the air,
her tail gently wrapped around your leg.
Body type: 151CM-L with Pink skin tone.
